name: scummvm-access
description: Make a ScummVM point-and-click adventure playable by blind and low-vision people (the ScummVM Access method): an accessibility pack format and validator, the pack-writing and engine-gotchas rules, and the game-as-tools drascula-mcp server for surveying a game by command. Use when authoring or validating an accessibility pack, writing the text a player hears, adapting a new ScummVM engine, or surveying a game through the MCP server.
